objective: Slow Down. Give Way. Choose Your Exit. Master three interconnected roundabouts.

missions.description: Approach Roundabout 1, reduce speed, yield to circulating traffic, and take the 1st exit East.

trafficRule.title: Yield to Right
trafficRule.description: Vehicles circulating inside have right of way. Slow down and yield at the give-way line.

missions.description: Drive to Roundabout 2, observe busy circulating traffic, wait for a safe gap, and merge smoothly.

trafficRule.title: Safe Gap Selection
trafficRule.description: Never cut in front of circulating traffic. Wait for an opening before entering.

missions.description: Navigate Roundabout 2 towards the North exit and stop to let pedestrians safely cross the zebra crossing.

trafficRule.title: Yield to Pedestrians
trafficRule.description: Always yield to pedestrians crossing exit and entry arms at roundabouts.

missions.description: Approach Roundabout 3, follow directional guidance, and take the 3rd exit towards Town Center.

trafficRule.title: Choose Correct Exit
trafficRule.description: Plan your route early, stay in your lane, and prepare your turn signal before exiting.

missions.description: Signal your exit, pass the final crossing cleanly, and reach the Town Center finish line.

trafficRule.title: Signal to Exit
trafficRule.description: Indicate your intention before exiting the roundabout to inform other road users.
